# spo_hub_site (Data Source)

Look up an existing HubSite object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The hub site description.
- `hub_site_id` (String) The hub site GUID (server-assigned).
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `logo_url` (String) The hub site logo URL.
- `requires_join_approval` (Boolean) Whether joining the hub requires approval.
- `title` (String) The hub site display name.
